content.comment_body: The [product_name] Demo is now also available in English, and the link has been updated. This demo version allows users to explore, create, simulate, save, and print circuit programs for all [product_name] devices on a PC. However, it does not allow for transferring programs to [product_name] hardware or communicating with these devices online; such functions require the full software version. Programs made in the demo can be imported and transferred using the full version. There is free online training available as well. The download includes the necessary files for supported operating systems.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are introduced to the [product_name] Demo, now available in English. The demo provides tools for creating, simulating, archiving, and printing circuit programs, but lacks support for transferring programs to hardware or communicating online, which are reserved for the full version. The demo serves as an accessible start for learning and testing its features, with hardware integration requiring an upgrade.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to test all circuit programming features in [product_name], including transferring and communicating programs with [product_name] hardware.
